edges.reason: AtomicBlue.swap forwards msg.sender as the recipient of the swap output.
AtomicBlue.multiPathSwap forwards msg.sender as the recipient of the swap output.
swapAndSend receives msg.sender and uses it for send destination and the Trade event.
swapAndSend invokes doDistributedSwap to execute the trade.
multiPathSwapAndSend invokes doDistributedSwap once per path hop.
swap delegates execution to swapAndSend.
multiPathSwap delegates execution to multiPathSwapAndSend.
swapAndSend performs an external ETH or ERC20 send to _receipient before completing.
multiPathSwapAndSend performs an external send to the caller supplied recipient.
doDistributedSwap computes _swap.input * _distribution.chunks[i] with no overflow checks.
doDistributedSwap divides by totalChunks which can be zero.
doDistributedSwap performs an arbitrary low-level call for direct exchange routing.
doDistributedSwap delegatecalls a caller supplied exchange module.
The delegatecall path is authorised by reading isModule[address(exchange)].
registerModule writes the isModule whitelist consumed by the delegatecall guard.
onlyRegistrar compares moduleRegistrar with msg.sender before registerModule executes.
onlyRegistrar compares moduleRegistrar with msg.sender before setNewRegistrar executes.
setNewRegistrar overwrites the privileged moduleRegistrar state variable.
registerModule reads moduleRegistrar through the onlyRegistrar modifier.
doDistributedSwap reads the post-swap buy token balance via balanceOf.
AtomicUtils.send executes recipient.send for ETH transfers.
AtomicUtils.send calls transfer on a caller supplied token contract.
send validates the optional ERC20 return value after transferring.
approve validates the optional ERC20 return value after approving.
claimTokenFromSenderTo calls transferFrom on a caller supplied token.

_swap parameter supplies amounts and tokens to swapAndSend.
_distribution parameter supplies exchange routing to swapAndSend.
Local _output is checked against minOutput and sent onward.
_receipient parameter is passed into AtomicUtils.send.
_swap parameter supplies the input amount used in doDistributedSwap.
Local exchange address is the target of the arbitrary low-level call.
Local thisInput is the product of the unchecked multiplication.
Token parameter selects the ETH or ERC20 send branch.
Recipient parameter is the destination of the low-level send.
Amount parameter is the value forwarded in the low-level send.
_token parameter is the token contract whose transferFrom is executed.
_gasToken parameter is the arbitrary contract called by freeFromUpTo.
_gasQtyPerToken parameter controls the freeFromUpTo amount.
_path parameter is indexed for validation and used to build each hop.
Local totalChunks is the denominator of the unchecked division.
Local startGas is subtracted from gasleft() to compute the gas token amount.
